claims.statement: Poland's UKE states that private 5G networks can operate commercially in the 3800-4200 MHz band under radio permits.
UKE publishes a current register category for private networks in that band, evidencing an operating permission regime rather than a hypothetical allocation.

contrary_evidence: UKE's framework allows industrial users to obtain spectrum for their own premises; many may not need a third-party site portfolio.

economics.acquisition_route: Renewable installers, industrial-property databases, and digital option-signing with landlords; integrators receive a searchable qualified inventory
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Option 100 sites by year 2 (unvalidated), activate 300 tenant sites by year 6 (unvalidated), and build contracted rent rights supporting founder equity above PLN 5 million by year 8 (unvalidated)
economics.founder_time: 10-15 hours per week during validation (unvalidated), with radio surveys delegated
economics.gross_margin_basis: Landlords receive most recurring rent while standardized surveys and contracting remain asset-light; 50-68% gross margin (unvalidated)
economics.payback: Acquisition cost recovered in 9-18 months after tenancy (unvalidated)
economics.pricing: PLN 15000-35000 site-readiness fee (unvalidated) and 12-20% of annual site rent (unvalidated)
economics.retention_or_repeat: Five-year site leases (unvalidated) with repeat expansion across nearby buildings

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A dense option estate and observed conversion data improve coverage planning and negotiation power
fingerprint.customer: Private-5G integrators, factories, logistics parks, utilities, and local wireless providers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Integrator inventory feed plus installer and industrial-landlord channels
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Ready-to-contract micro-sites with standardized technical and legal dossiers
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Integrator or industrial tenant pays when accepting a technically qualified site and executing a lease
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A private network design lacks a permissioned location with suitable coverage, power, or backhaul

founder_fit: Quantitative geospatial ranking is AI- and data-leveraged.
Renewable and industrial contacts provide an initial property wedge.
risks: Long enterprise sales cycles and low site activation rates.
Planning, electromagnetic, and landlord restrictions vary by site.
The stated PLN 70000 startup capital requirement is unvalidated.

structure.commercial_archetype: Wholesale infrastructure leasing through an optioned micro-site estate
structure.control_point: Contractual roof or land access options with pre-agreed lease terms, technical dossiers, and landlord authority
structure.critical_dependency: Industrial private-network demand must require off-premise or multi-building radio sites, and each deployment still needs lawful permits and interference coordination

thesis: Secure conditional access options on suitable factory roofs, silos, warehouses, and renewable sites, document power/backhaul and radio geometry, then lease standardized micro-site bundles to private-network integrators and industrial users. The company does not speculate in spectrum; it controls permissioned physical locations that shorten deployment.
title: Private-5G Micro-Site Estate
uncertainties: Whether integrators value pre-optioned sites before winning end customers.
Which industrial clusters have real multi-building coverage gaps?
